arguments.command:
python -c "
from argparse import Namespace
import semver

# Test all bump types
test_cases = [
    ('major', '1.2.3', '2.0.0'),
    ('minor', '1.2.3', '1.3.0'),
    ('patch', '1.2.3', '1.2.4'),
    ('prerelease', '1.2.3-rc.1', '1.2.3-rc.2'),
    ('build', '1.2.3+build.1', '1.2.3+build.2'),
]

for bump_type, version, expected in test_cases:
    args = Namespace(bump=bump_type, version=version)
    result = semver.cmd_bump(args)
    status = '✓' if result == expected else '✗'
    print(f'{status} cmd_bump({bump_type}, {version!r}): {result} (expected {expected})')
"
